items.text: IntelliJ-style commit graph for every branch and remote, fast with 50k+ commits.
Select several commits to read their combined change, file by file.
IntelliJ-style diff viewer: side by side or unified, word highlights, connector bands, image diffs.
Live uncommitted changes of every worktree, and one combined view across repos and machines.
One daemon per machine, one client for all of them: web panel, desktop app or React components.
Git actions: fetch, pull, push, commit, checkout, branches, tags, cherry-pick, revert, reset, merge, rebase, stash.
Agent checkpoint commits (Jean, T3 Code) hidden by default.
Themes and accents, optional tabs, server list, self-update from the CLI or the client.
